pain_points.statement: Invoicing processes are severely delayed due to data discrepancies across systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: Finance requires a fixed-fee agreement with milestone payments tied directly to specific outcomes.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'll give you a fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: Achieving a 30% reduction in dispatch time avoids $320k in hiring costs, while normalizing DSO unlocks $1.4M in working capital.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a fundamental disagreement on the approved Phase 1 budget amount.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita explicitly states the approved budget is capped at $300,000, whereas Sarah believes they had agreed on a range of $250,000 to $400,000.

pain_points.statement: The core dispatch software Routemaster has significant technical debt and a fragile codebase that slows feature delivery.
pain_points.source_excerpt: the codebase is too fragile. Every change takes three times as long as it should.

pain_points.statement: There is excessive manual data entry required between Salesforce and the custom dispatch tool.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: The CTO prefers replacing the custom platform entirely with a third-party SaaS dispatch platform.
desired_state.source_excerpt: dispatch-as-a-service, full SaaS platform, integrates with Salesforce out of the box

success_criteria.statement: The integration layer built in Phase 1 should ensure 60-70% of the solution remains viable after a platform transition.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal initiatives to fix the integration and technical workflow problems have failed twice.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Manual operational processes severely hinder dispatcher efficiency.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Our dispatcher workflow is killing us.

pain_points.statement: Drivers are dissatisfied with the performance and usability of the mobile application.

desired_state.statement: Phase 1 will focus on resolving invoicing data reconciliation and streamlining dispatcher workflows.
desired_state.source_excerpt: focus on the invoicing reconciliation first because that's directly affecting cash flow

success_criteria.statement: Operationally reduce load dispatch time by 30% and return invoicing turnaround to industry standards.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time per load and a return to industry-standard DSO

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders hold conflicting commitments regarding the operational target delivery date.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I think Q4 is more realistic if we're doing it right.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita and Sarah require a Q3 pilot completion to protect funding, whereas Marcus explicitly rejects Q3 and targets Q4.

risks_unknowns.statement: Upcoming ELD compliance regulations on November 15 present legal and operational risks if not accounted for.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.

pain_points.statement: Leadership disagrees on whether the core strategic focus should be workflow optimization or software replacement.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.

pain_points.statement: Acquisitions made during rapid company growth remain incompletely integrated.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Implement modular workflow improvements designed to remain functional regardless of future system replacement decisions.
desired_state.source_excerpt: building this with an explicit eye toward whatever Routemaster's eventual replacement looks like

success_criteria.statement: Launch a production pilot before the end of September to prevent budget reallocation.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

risks_unknowns.statement: Scoping short-term workflow fixes without replacing legacy platforms risks squandering capital on temporary solutions.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We're scoping a band-aid because we set a budget that only buys a band-aid.
